title: Most ‘Organic’ Food Is FAKE (Here’s Proof)
summary: A health coach and a GAPS-diet doctor claim glyphosate contaminates most food, the organic label is corrupted, and only local farms can be trusted.

assertions.quote: you can assume that if a food is not organic it's likely contaminated with glyphosate
they are damaging that Harmony that balance in your microbial community in the body
it's also used during the final stages of harvest sprayed on wheat to dry it out
organic standards have been degraded and corrupted we cannot trust the organic label in supermarkets anymore
you're just paying more for the same produce
if they ate one orange we'd have to eat the equivalent of seven oranges today

verdicts.note: Historical comparisons show modest declines in some minerals, mostly from high-yield varieties, nowhere near several-fold losses.

assertions.quote: we have to find real true organic farmers and the good place to start is uh the farmers markets
our food is left covered in toxic chemical residue that doesn't wash dry or cook off
there's Hydroponics and there are other practices which have no place in proper organic agriculture
